title: Saved by Grace, Be Ready for Every Good Work

questions.question: Remind them to be submissive to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every ____,
questions.explanation: Titus 3:1 (ESV): "Remind them to be submissive to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,"

questions.question: to speak evil of no one, to avoid quarreling, to be gentle, and to show perfect ____ toward all people.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:2 (ESV): "to speak evil of no one, to avoid quarreling, to be gentle, and to show perfect courtesy toward all people."

questions.question: For we ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, led astray, slaves to various ____ and pleasures
questions.explanation: Titus 3:3 (ESV): "For we ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, led astray, slaves to various passions and pleasures, passing our days in malice and envy, hated by others and hating one another."

questions.question: But when the ____ and lovingkindness of God our Savior appeared,
questions.explanation: Titus 3:4 (ESV): "But when the goodness and lovingkindness of God our Savior appeared,"

questions.question: he saved us, not because of works done by us in righteousness, but according to his own ____,
questions.explanation: Titus 3:5 (ESV): "he saved us, not because of works done by us in righteousness, but according to his own mercy, by the washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit,"

questions.question: by the ____ of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit,
questions.explanation: Titus 3:5 (ESV): "by the washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit,"

questions.question: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior, so that being justified by his ____ we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:6-7 (ESV): "whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior, so that being justified by his grace we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life."

questions.question: The saying is trustworthy, and I want you to insist on these things, so that those who have believed in God may be careful to devote themselves to ____.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:8 (ESV): "The saying is trustworthy, and I want you to insist on these things, so that those who have believed in God may be careful to devote themselves to good works."

questions.question: But avoid foolish ____, genealogies, dissensions, and quarrels about the law, for they are unprofitable and worthless.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:9 (ESV): "But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, dissensions, and quarrels about the law, for they are unprofitable and worthless."

questions.question: As for a person who stirs up ____, after warning him once and then twice, have nothing more to do with him,
questions.explanation: Titus 3:10 (ESV): "As for a person who stirs up division, after warning him once and then twice, have nothing more to do with him,"

questions.question: knowing that such a person is warped and sinful; he is ____.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:11 (ESV): "knowing that such a person is warped and sinful; he is self-condemned."

questions.question: When Paul sends ____ or Tychicus to Titus, Titus is to do his best to come to Paul at Nicopolis.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:12 (ESV): "When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there."

questions.question: Paul tells Titus to do his best to speed ____ the lawyer and Apollos on their way; see that they lack nothing.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:13 (ESV): "Do your best to speed Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way; see that they lack nothing."

questions.question: And let our people learn to devote themselves to good works, so as to help cases of urgent ____, and not be unfruitful.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:14 (ESV): "And let our people learn to devote themselves to good works, so as to help cases of urgent need, and not be unfruitful."

questions.question: All who are with Paul send greetings. Greet those who love us in the ____.
questions.explanation: Titus 3:15 (ESV): "All who are with me send greetings to you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all."

key_verse_text: But when the goodness and lovingkindness of God our Savior appeared, he saved us, not because of works done by us in righteousness, but according to his own mercy, by the washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit,
